evidence.quote:
remember returns a receipt in
seconds

observations.why: Ratifying a contract that guarantees a fast, reliable receipt appeals to stability/security of the system and mastery of its design.

evidence.quote: no lost work if the client drops the receipt

observations.why: The appeal is to durability and security — work survives even when a component fails, a conservation value.

evidence.quote:
the agent either polls the run or
gets the reaction piggybacked on a later call

observations.why: The agent self-directs how it consumes results — polling or piggybacking — appealing to self-origination and capability of the consumer.
